data: What is the colour of the cell corresponding to layer 3 and bin 6?

The question asks for the color of the cell corresponding to layer 3 and bin 6. From the caption, we know that the figure shows frequency-based classification accuracy on states from the ENRU decoder. The color bar at the bottom indicates the range of values, with blue representing lower values and red representing higher values. 

Looking at the figure, the cell in row 3 (layer 3) and column 6 (bin 6) has a value of approximately 0.515. According to the color bar, this value corresponds to a light blue color. Therefore, the color of the cell corresponding to layer 3 and bin 6 is light blue.
